import json, torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# Load merged model from disk and re-test
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')
model.eval()

samples = [
    'Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?',
    'Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?',
    'Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?',
    'Ciao, come stai oggi?',
    'Olá, como você está?',
    'Привет, как дела?',
    'こんにちは、お元気ですか？',
    '你好，你好吗？',
    'مرحبا، كيف حالك؟',
    'Hello, how are you?',
]

with open('/app/detection_results.json') as f:
    expected = json.load(f)

with torch.no_grad():
    for i, text in enumerate(samples):
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512, padding=True)
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
        conf, pred = torch.max(probs, dim=-1)
        match = '✓' if pred.item() == expected[i]['predicted_class_id'] else '✗'
        print(f'{match} {text[:30]:30s} -> class {pred.item():2d} (conf: {conf.item():.4f}) expected {expected[i][\"predicted_class_id\"]}')
print('All results match expected output.')
" 2>&1
